metadata.title: Arya: My Ledger
metadata.description: A quiet personal ledger for recording income and expenses — simple, private, no payments.

installGuide.title: Install Arya
installGuide.body: To install Arya: on Android, open the browser menu > Add to Home screen; on iPhone, tap Share > Add to Home Screen.

offline.title: You're offline
offline.description: There is no internet connection. Open the page again when you're back online.

calendar.dateHint: Calendar: {calendar}. Format: year/month/day; Persian digits are also accepted.

settings.title: Account settings
settings.subtitle: Choose how dates and the calendar are shown in your ledger.
settings.calendarDescription: Dates are always stored in Gregorian format in the database. This choice only changes how dates are displayed and entered.
settings.calendarHint: Jalali is suggested for Persian-language accounts.

errors.generic: We couldn't save your settings. Please try again.

login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Sign in to open your personal ledger.

register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: Set up your personal ledger in a few seconds.

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.subtitle: Enter the email on your account and we'll send you a recovery link.

resetPassword.title: Choose a new password
resetPassword.subtitle: Pick a fresh, secure password for your account.
resetPassword.invalidDescription: It has expired or was already used. Request a new one.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.emailNotConfirmed: Confirm your email before signing in.
errors.emailAlreadyRegistered: An account already exists for this email.
errors.weakPassword: That password is too weak. Use at least 6 characters and a secure combination.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests. Please wait a moment and try again.
errors.samePassword: The new password must be different from the current one.
errors.sessionExpired: Your link has expired. Please request a new recovery email.
errors.callback: We couldn't verify your account. Sign in again or reopen the link.

messages.confirmationSent: Your account is created. Open the confirmation link in your email to activate it.
messages.resetSent: If an account exists for this email, a recovery link has been sent.
messages.checkSpam: If you don't see the email, check your spam folder too.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Your ledger and account, in one calm place.
dashboard.emptyDescription: Recording income and expenses will arrive here soon.

ledgers.title: Ledgers
ledgers.subtitle: View your personal ledgers, rename them, or create a new one.

delete.question: Are you sure?
delete.description: This ledger will be permanently deleted.

empty.title: No ledgers yet
empty.description: Create your first ledger to get started.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.limitReached: On the free plan, you can only have one ledger.

openingBalances.title: Opening balance
openingBalances.hint: Enter a starting amount for each currency; amounts can be zero or negative.

errors.amountNoFraction: This currency doesn't allow decimal places.
errors.amountTooManyFractions: This currency allows at most two decimal places.
errors.generic: We couldn't save the opening balances. Please try again.

records.title: Records
records.subtitle: View and manage this ledger's income, payments, and loans.
records.emptyDescription: Add your first received, paid, lent, or borrowed record.
records.noResultsDescription: Change the filters or search terms.

errors.amountPositive: The amount must be greater than zero.
errors.amountNoFraction: This currency doesn't allow decimal places.
errors.amountTooManyFractions: This currency allows at most two decimal places.
errors.contactCreate: We couldn't create the contact. Please try again.
errors.generic: We couldn't save the record. Please try again.

transactionList.deleteDescription: This record will be permanently deleted.
transactionList.deleteError: We couldn't delete the record. Please try again.

contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.subtitle: Manage the people you exchange money with. Each contact's balance is tracked separately per currency.
contacts.emptyDescription: Add people you receive from, pay, or exchange loans with.
contacts.deleteDescription: The contact will be deleted, but their records will remain.
contacts.deleteError: We couldn't delete the contact. Please try again.

errors.generic: We couldn't save the contact. Please try again.

summary.title: Summary
summary.subtitle: Opening balance, ledger balance, contact receivables and payables, and income and payments, separated by currency.
summary.emptyDescription: Once you add a record or a contact, the summary will appear here.
summary.currencyBalancesHint: Balance comes from the opening balance and all ledger records; receivables and payables come only from contact balances.

contactDetail.emptyHistoryDescription: No received, paid, lent, or borrowed records for this contact yet.

workspace.loadError: We couldn't load this ledger's data.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: This address doesn't exist or has moved.

footer.note: A personal ledger for recording only — no payments.
